name: Bräus
summary: Partnership trick-taking game from Gotland with mostly unplayable cards and automatic seven tricks.
rules_text: Use 32-36 cards from standard pack removing 2-5. Eighteen cards are playable with a special ranking topped by Jack of clubs and hearts, then Bräus cards, then others. Four sevens are auto-tricks: when on lead you lay any sevens you hold, each counts as a trick, they cannot beat or be beaten. Remaining 14 cards are dead except King of clubs as outcome tie-breaker. 4 players get 9 cards each, 6 players get 6, in two alternating partnership teams. Forehand leads first with sevens then a playable card. Clockwise each player must play a higher playable card if able, otherwise pass without discarding. Highest card played wins the trick. Winner leads next trick with own sevens then a playable. If leader has none, lead passes. First team to 6 tricks scores 1 point, 2 points if they won first six straight (Jan). If 5-5 on playables, team holding King of clubs gets sixth and wins. Otherwise deal is void.
rating_reason: Specific Karnöffel trump trick-taking game, playable turn-based.
